elsewhere.note: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.
Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
“The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
